pages.text:
Matrix entries and units
Aij is the response of detector i to one concentration unit of constituent j.
[Aij] = signalconcentration , [Ac] = signal.
The row and column meanings are part of the model.

pages.title: Elimination by hand
pages.text:
Elimination by hand
Subtract 0.20 times the ﬁrst detector equation from the second:
1.15cB = y2 − 0.20y1.
Then cA = y1 − 0.25cB. The numerical solve carries out equivalent linear algebra.

pages.title: A residual scaled to the problem
pages.text:
A residual scaled to the problem
A dimensionless residual measure is
η = ∥Aˆc − y∥2
∥A∥2∥ˆc∥2 + ∥y∥2
.
A small η supports the algebraic solve. It does not establish accurate calibration or
accurate observations. If both numerator and denominator are zero, report the exact zero
residual separately.
